title: Reballing flip chip GPUs is BULLSHIT - the truth about dead laptop GPUs & repairing them.
summary: Louis Rossmann argues that reballing flip-chip GPUs is not a real fix for dead laptop GPUs. He explains why such repairs and oven reflow tricks fail and what is actually happening with failing hardware.
why: HN people cite it to debunk oven-reflow and reballing repair folklore, and as part of Rossmann's critiques of Apple hardware quality.

quote.text: It's pretty funny. He thinks oven reflows are a bad idea.
